messages:
Noah Rivera: Heads-up — Harper joins Mon 11/08. Drafting a compact manager + HR checklist for week 0/1 so we dont miss access or context. Please review.

Maya Singh: Nice. Can you keep Day1 < 6h? Back-to-back is rough.

Noah Rivera: Agreed. Lean day. Proposed Day0 (& before start):
- Hardware ordered + imaging ticket to IT (MacBook or approved thin client)
- Create GitHub, Slack, Okta, Jira, Confluence accounts; add to org groups (eng, infra-read)
- Invite to onboarding Confluence space and add to #eng-intros slack channel
- Assign buddy (Ben suggested) and create onboarding Jira epic
- Pre-create calendar blocks: Day1 AM manager welcome (30m), Day1 PM env setup (2h), weekly 1:1 recurring

it-ops-bot: create-ticket --queue=it-setup --summary="Imaging + VPN for Harper K." --assignee=imaging-team -> TKT-5110

Ben Liu: Happy to be buddy. My week looks clear Mon/Tue afternoons for pairing.

Noah Rivera: Day1 (timeboxed, prefer remote-friendly):
- 09:00-09:30 Manager welcome: team org context, expectations, immediate priorities
- 09:30-10:00 HR: benefits + payroll basics (opt-in links sent)
- 10:15-12:15 Dev environment setup with buddy (clone onboarding repo + run tests)
- 12:15-13:00 Team intro lunch (opt-in)
- 13:00-14:00 Quick product & runtime overview (console tour)
- 14:15-16:00 First tiny task: update docs or fix a linting issue -> open PR with help

Maya Singh: Add 15m at 14:00 for security checklist: password manager, MFA, secret scanning overview.

Noah Rivera: Will do. Buddy checklist for week1:
- Pair on onboarding repo: `github.com/redwood/onboarding` -> first-pr workflow
- Run `./scripts/dev-setup.sh`, `make test-unit`, and a staging runtime smoke test
- Shadow an infra sync (Wed 10:00) and attend one triage meeting
- Document environment quirks in Confluence page `onboarding/<name>`

Maya Singh: HR notes: have new hire complete I-9 + tax forms before end of Day1. Also send benefits Q&A drop-in invite for Day3 11:00.

Harper Kim: Quick Q: will I get read-only access to Dedicated during week1? I want to follow the runtime demo.

it-ops-bot: Added Harper Kim to `dedicated-readers`. ACL ticket ACL-997 opened for escalations.

Noah Rivera: I'll draft a 30/60/90 and share by Day4. Short version: 30d = complete onboarding & ship 2 small PRs, 60d = own feature + tests, 90d = lead a minor rollout + present learnings. Make metrics explicit when shared.

Ben Liu: Tip for first PR: pick `docs/quick-start.md` update or a single lint fix in `onboarding` repo — quick approvals.

Maya Singh: Manager checklist before start (quick):
- Confirm hardware & imaging done 48h before start
- Calendar invites + intro thread in #eng
- Approve buddy time blocks
- Draft 30/60/90 and share by Day5

Noah Rivera: I'll post final calendar + Confluence page tonight. Ping here for any missing access. :rocket:
